notes.title: - XENOBREAKERS: CTD v1.02 - ULTRAWIDE & OPTIMIZATION UPDATE -
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey folks![/b]  
Welcome to Patch v1.02 of XENOBREAKERS: Classic Tower Defense – [b]the Ultrawide & Optimization Update![/b] [/p][p]Whether you're just getting started or jumping back in, this update brings a range of improvements to help the game look and run better across the board. From expanded ultrawide support to performance tweaks and quality-of-life additions, we’ve made the experience a bit smoother and more responsive all around.

Further bug reports are always welcome to be placed on our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3389440/discussions/0/603027846149975644/"]BUGS AND FEEDBACK[/url] page. 
Read on for all the new features, fixes, balancing tweaks and things on our radar. 
Thanks for being part of the mission. o7  

[b]/// Additional Features ///[/b]
  
- Added Ultrawide Support and Aspect Ratio Selection. 
	- User now has the ability to change Aspect Ratio; 16:9, 16:10, 21:9, 32:9.
 	- We expanded all level sizes to remove Black Bars across all supported aspect ratios.  
- Added extra Key Bindings for panning, users can now also use WASD(standard), remappable in key bindings. 
- Music now continues playing throughout Tutorial, Comic screens and the Pause Menu. 
- The Acquisitions Tab now flashes when unspent Tokens are available. 
- The Game Initiation screen now features the option to change UI Color alongside the already existing Language Selection. 
- Further optimization improvements across all levels.  

[b]/// Bugfixes ///[/b]  

- The Mech Drop Ability would sometimes block enemies. 
- The Mech Drop's Jetpack particles would sometimes linger for a second after de-spawn, this is now fixed. 
- The Mech Drop would sometimes fire infinitely on a target that is too close to it without dealing damage. 
- Friendly Troopers would let enemies pile up on them. They should now always target 1 enemy per trooper. 
- Friendly Troopers would sometimes still swing after death. 
- Friendly Troopers Mk I - II - III now dissolve in the correct color. 
- Friendly Legionnaire Troopers now always prioritize moving toward the rally point when it is changed. 
- The Soldier Bug no longer gets stuck in combat and should behave correctly now. 
- Fixed a bug where the Lifter Droid wouldn't damage Troopers. 
- The Corporate Mecha enemy now uses their smoke grenade properly. 
- Fixed a bug where you couldn't zoom after closing the pause menu, zoom is now disabled while the pause menu is active. 
- The User sometimes had to double click to open the pause menu. 
- The active database element would sometimes still be highlighted without the info tab open. 
- The 50.000 kill achievement would not unlock unless the kill total was exactly 50.000. 
- Achievement stats should no longer write/reset when steam achievement stats were not cached. 
- The Speed Up button no longer flickers when clicking elements while input is held down. 
- The Tower Build Menu would sometimes render the wrong radial, it should now display the correct one. - Opening the Pause Menu would sometimes flicker in Fullscreen mode, this is now fixed.  

[b]/// Changes ///[/b]  

- Unlimited FPS option display has been changed from "++" to "∞". 
- Smoothened User Experience with the Options Menu, Save Deletion and Save Slot Difficulty selection. 
- Improvements on the Portuguese-BR, Spanish and Russian localizations and clipping cleanup. 
- Improved some Achievement localizations. 
- Database and Tutorial videos are no longer stuck on the last video played, they now pop in once they are loaded. 
- Resolution options now display from highest to lowest in the resolution selection box. 
- Tower Build Menu's Info Display now appears on top, this sometimes clipped with background art with localizations. 
- Player Statistics' HUD piece has a new standard visual to visually support ultrawide placements. 
- The Aqcuisitions tab reset button is disabled when no skills are unlocked. 
- Removed Dev Keybind for Pause Menu. 
- Significantly reduced the game's file size.  

[b]/// BALANCING ///[/b] 

- Spawner Bugs are no longer stopped by Troopers. 
- Buffed Neural Nexus Health, Level 11 boss. 
- Buffed Aegis Behemoth Health, Level 16 boss.  

[b]/// FUTURE UPDATE WORKPOINTS ///[/b]

- Spanish Localization Clipping Adjustments. 
- Simplified Chinese Localization Update. 
- Bug Reports. [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: First week notes! (Patch notes #1.01)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45369754/b71c2dfd782a656b3726f69dcffad624b48609b5.png[/img]
First a word of thanks!

Thank you so much for supporting our game! We have loved watching streamers and YouTubers enjoy our little game! We are committed to making sure that any issues brought to our attention will be resolved as quick as possible! That being said, we made this game in 8 months time. And the team is rather exhausted. So we are taking a short break until the 5th of May. 

We want to make sure that we can look at any remaining issues with a clear head. We haven't been reported any real game breaking bugs so far. So a little nerve wracking to take the time off, but it is definitely necessary!

I will list a few of the bugs we have fixed so far already, and then a short listing of things that are definitely already on the top of our needs to be "fixed and improved" list.

[h2]Bugs fixed:[/h2]
[list] 
[*]Language choice: There was a bug where in some language region it auto defaulted to German. This has been resolved.
[*]Save slot: There was an issue where if you had a save slot that was played through all the save data bled through to the next save file created. Even on hardcore mode.
[*]Bugs stuck on position: Not entirely fixed. It should be a lot less frequent now however. When a soldier bug is stuck camping next to a Trooper Tower moving the rally point will break them lose of their aggro loop. (haven't figured out yet why they are doing that.)[/list]
[h2]Bugs on our to do list:[/h2]
[list]
[*]There is still quite of bit of optimizing that we intend to do. This is a priority for us and will be completed as fast as possible upon our return.
[*]Pathing issues: As said we were able to diminish how often it happens, but we will get it out fully!
[*]Widescreen support: We put black bars on the side temporarily. Since there was a lot of stretching in game. We will once we return get support for widescreen back in a stable manner!
[*]Late achievements: This is an annoying one, most seem to work except for the 50.000 killed one, so we are going to fix that one as soon as we can as well. 
[*]The player Mech is blocking creatures it shouldn't as soon as the gun upgrade and shield upgrade are bought. That is not intended.
[*]The Corporate Mecha should fire smoke grenades, which it isn't right now. But it will soon!
[*]Spawners are being stopped by troopers; they should not be. 
[*]Sometimes the Legionnaire broken tower on level 12 doesn't function as it should.[/list]
[h2]Balancing:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Infantry mk II and mk III towers have had damage reduced by 10%.
[*]Heavy Gunner damage was reduced by 30%. 
[*]Level 02 wave density has been diminished to have less of a difficulty spike in the second level. As it was throwing people into the deep end too soon. [/list]

[h1]Exciting News: [b]XENOBREAKERS: Classic Tower Defense[/b] is [b]LIVE![/b] [/h1]

After 8 months of hard work, we're thrilled to announce the launch of our game: XENOBREAKERS: Classic Tower Defense!

If you're a fan of the classic tower defense genre and want to experience it with a fresh, modern twist—this game is for you.

[b]👉 Available now – consider buying and supporting us![/b]
We'd love to hear your thoughts, feedback, and suggestions.

A massive thank you from all of us at [b]Couch Potato Studios[/b]!
Your support means everything. 🙌

Stay tuned—we’ll be keeping you updated on future patches and content drops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45369754/740967110145fe7c815dec553efedc890b1a140b.png[/img]
[b]Game Summary:[/b]
[i]XENOBREAKERS is a classic tower defense game with 3D graphics set in our own Sci-Fi universe. You must stop enemies from passing through your defensive gates by placing towers and activating powerful abilities—like the devastating Orbital Laser! Inspired by genre-defining classics.[/i]
